title: Industry Writing
subtitle: 80 Level & LinkedIn Pulse
body: Feature writing for 80 Level, one of the game industry’s larger trade publications, plus long-form technical and strategy pieces on digital asset management and publisher relations. The GDC piece is a networking guide written for introverts that says plainly what most conference advice hides — that sharing creative work is a vulnerable act and the anxiety is legitimate. Same instinct as the rest of this page, in a different register: name the internal state instead of performing past it.
